name: PixelBlast-TS-TW

frames.best_why: No frame shows the effect; all six are the same white headline on plain black.
frames.render_note: Only the demo's headline and subtitle are visible; no pixel pattern appears in any frame.

tagline: A dotted field of coloured pixels ripples outward where you click.
summary: A field of small coloured pixel shapes drifts like noise across the panel, and each click sends a spreading ring through it. A liquid wobble can distort the pattern near the pointer.
appearance: In every recorded frame the panel is flat black with a bold white heading and a line of grey text centred in it. Nothing of the pixel field, its colour or its texture is visible.
behaviour: Nothing changes across the frames: the headline stays fixed and no ripple or pixel motion appears. Per the code, clicks push a ring through the dot field and pointer movement can wobble a liquid layer.
demo_content: White heading "Click anywhere." with the line "Every click sends a ripple through the pixels."
search_phrases: ripple through a grid of dots
playful pixel background for a hero
use_when: A playful landing page wants an interactive dotted backdrop that reacts to clicks.
avoid_when: You need something visible on first paint: the recording shows no pattern at all, so verify it renders before shipping.
customise: Shape variant, pixel size and jitter, colour, pattern scale and density, ripples, liquid distortion, speed, edge fade and transparency are props.
weight_why: A Three.js shader with an optional liquid pass renders every frame.

a11y.note: The canvas has an aria-label but no keyboard route to the click ripples and no reduced-motion handling.

issues: The recording never shows the pixel field: every frame is the demo headline on plain black.
